q: The log-sum inequality states that for non-negative aᵢ, bᵢ:
exp: Log-sum inequality: Σᵢ aᵢ log(aᵢ/bᵢ) ≥ (Σaᵢ) log(Σaᵢ/Σbᵢ). This follows from Jensen's inequality applied to the convex function t log t. It is used to prove non-negativity of KL divergence, convexity of mutual information, and many other information inequalities.
